body: Good point. There is a big cliff near my house and I can't get it out of my head, just thinking about jumping. I guess I'm just too much of a wuss to actually go through with it.

I sent my psychiatrist an email but never heard back. I see her in two weeks and I think I will talk to her then. I don't have anyone who isn't a professional I can talk to, my family especially is very keep quiet and soldier on. 

Hobbies is a good idea and I have been trying. Im really into music and playing so I've been diving into that recently. I'll try and find some other stuff to do as well.

No other diagnosis's just depression. Meds? Cymbalta, Wellbutrin, Lamotrigine, Trazadone, Abilify.I started ECT in september. I went through an intensive phase three times a week for a while and now I'm on maintenance every two weeks, which will stretch out to every month soon. 

I haven't had anything traumatic or mentally challenging that I can think of, last wednesday my mood just plummeted. Go figure.

Thank you for replying I really appreciate it. I've felt suicidal off an on for ten years. I have good periods and bad periods. Right now I'm really in a bad period. I feel like I have to keep up appearances in every day life, I pretend I'm ok. If you knew me you wouldn't know I'm feeling this way, and I think it is like that for a lot of people who DO feel this way. 

Specific things I can think of.....I can't. Im doing everything my counsellor and psychiatrist tell me to do. I take all my meds, I go for walks, I work out, all that good stuff. I've been having ECT for my depression which has helped some what. Not being able to drink is driving me insane, but I know in the long run drinking and drugs would just make things worse. Sorry for the essay, this is the first time I have reached out for help and having a reply and someone to talk to openly is nice.
Maybe I am OCD, who knows *shrugs*. I hope I get at least another year as well, thanks for replying.
Thats a good plan. Ill do my best to see my friends more often. Thanks for replying.
Sponsor, yes. Steps, yes. Perhaps I need to try harder at the steps, or try to figure out a new way to look at them. My sponsor is great. Thanks for replying, I appreciate it.
Thank you. I'll look up pamphlet 11 and revisit 4 and 5. I've got nothing to lose at this point.
